required.criterion: Title/abstract indicates Automatic Speech Recognition, ASR, or speech-to-text rather than speech synthesis, speaker recognition, or general speech processing alone.
Title/abstract indicates African languages, named African languages, or an African low-resource-language setting.
Title/abstract indicates ASR datasets, ASR models, ASR training methods, or ASR evaluation metrics/techniques for African languages.
When ASR and African-language scope are clear but low-resource framing, duplicate status, or quality score is not observable, keep maybe and defer final confirmation to Stage 2.

exclusion_criteria.criterion: Title/abstract clearly indicates the study is not about ASR or speech-to-text.
Title/abstract clearly indicates the study is not about African languages.
